title: 86 ## Local and Special Laws During 1972 there was a sharp decrease in the incidence of offences under local and special laws committed by juveniles. The decrease was as much, as 54% over 1971. Offences under Prohibition Act, SIT Act, Motor Vehicle Act and Indian Railway Act accounted for this significant decrease. Offences under Gambling Act and Prohibition Act accounted for about 45% of the total offences under local and special laws. Table 32 presents the relevant statistics at all India level.
